notes: Alpha cutout CARDS for retro vegetation: each slice is one leaf cluster with its twigs. Vegetation is built from these on crossed planes and domes, never from per-leaf geometry. Deliberately airy -- a crowded card mipmaps into a solid block, and the mesh is supposed to carry the silhouette.

provenance.processing: background=transparent, trimmed to alpha bounds, fitted to 512px, clear texels flooded with the cluster mean to stop a dark filtering fringe; packed one row
